result.summary: The home screen is mostly polished; the only clear visual defect is a duplicate restaurant card in the Fastest near you carousel.

issues.description: The first two cards in Fastest near you are identical (same Green Bowl Poké image, name, time, and delivery fee), which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel maps unique restaurants and de-duplicates items so each card represents a different venue.
